name: ecommerce-analytics-dashboard
description: AI-Powered E-commerce Analytics Dashboard with ML-based Customer Segmentation and Sales Forecasting

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ..
scripts.both: concurrently "npm run backend" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.check:env: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('./frontend/.env.local')) { console.error('\x1b[31m[ERROR]\x1b[0m frontend/.env.local not found! Copy .env.local.example and configure Supabase credentials.'); process.exit(1); } console.log('\x1b[32m[OK]\x1b[0m Environment configured');"
